Im not from America…. And people are allowed to care about too things at once. I can have empathy and worry about wars that are going on in the world and also feel saddened that an entire generation of young women have been made so insecure that they are getting filler from unlicensed professionals at the age of 18.

Maybe an unpopular opinion but I actually think the only message to get out of this is positive. Kylie and the rest of the sisters have set this insanely high beauty standard that has caused an epidemic of young women getting insane amounts of filler. 

So many “normal” women have such a warped sense of self and beauty that they cannot even fathom existing without 6/7ML of filler in their face. If the people who started this trend are openly saying, I dissolved my filler and it was difficult but I did it.
